study type: Clinical audit and population-based surveillance study
exposure: Adherence to BHIVA guidelines for HIV management in pregnancy
outcome: Timeliness of referral and ART initiation
Planned mode of delivery for women with HIV
cohort: The study included 1483 pregnancies in women with HIV in the UK, with expected delivery dates between January 1, 2013, and June 30, 2014.
finding: Pregnant women in the UK are managed largely in accordance with BHIVA guidelines, although improvements are needed in timely referral and ART initiation to ensure optimal outcomes.
mod_finding: Eleven percent of services reported local policies contrary to guidelines regarding delivery mode for women with a viral load below 50 copies/mL at 36 weeks or more, and 27% of women eligible for vaginal delivery planned a Cesarean section.
cross-section timing: Data was collected for pregnancies with an expected delivery date from January 1, 2013, to June 30, 2014.
gest_age: Mentioned in guidelines for delivery mode (>36 weeks gestation) but not as a cohort characteristic or inclusion criterion.
